reviews.text: My dog used to be so fearful of the groomers. Other places that I've taken him to, he would freeze and stop walking the moment he realized where he was going. With Pupper Palace, he walks right in and loves his groomer, Belen. I'm so happy I found this place, as my dog's comfort is my highest priority. And he always looks fantastic on top of that. Thank you Belen! Zumo loves you ❤️
So kind and thoughtful about how to approach grooming with my newly adopted girl. She was fresh and beautiful (and happy!) when they were done!
The team at Pupper Palace is awesome. Juno has seen Julie and Belen - they were sooo patient and awesome with our puppy!
Julie does a great job with my dog. Highly recommend.

I brought my Toy Poodle puppy, Minoo, to Pupper Palace today for her very first grooming session (bath, nail clipping, and a haircut). Initially, the lovely groomer let me know that since it was Minoo's first time and she was a bit nervous, they might not be able to do a full-body cut. I was a little disappointed at first but totally understood

that the puppy's comfort comes first.

However, when I came back an hour later, I was absolutely amazed! They miraculously managed to give Minoo a complete, incredibly neat, and beautiful haircut. The groomer was so patient, gentle, and skilled with her. I was so thrilled with the result that I had to leave a good tip! A huge thank you to the wonderful groomer and the owner for making little Minoo look so gorgeous. We will definitely be regular customers!
Pennys go-to for the smoothest nail grind! Makes her little paws 100% more tolerable when she’s stepping all over me.

We have been going to pupper palace for a few years now. Our pug does not like bathing or nail trims, and at home it's at least a two person job, but Julie has a magic touch and always has her looking and smelling great! Thanks Julie!

2/2 perfect haircuts for our puppy from both Julie and Belen! We won’t take our doggo anywhere else from now on! I cant stop looking at him, so handsome!!!

We can’t walk by without him wanting to go in to say hi!

We had some unintentionally hilarious haircuts that were performed by other salons in the city… so we were nervous going in… but these gals were absolutely perfect! Thank you both! 💜
All smiles from Higgs and Sudo after a great grooming by Belen at Pupper Palace. Happy dogs :)

A long overdue review, would highly recommend Pupper Palace.

Julie is our go-to groomer. She has such a calming presence, and does an exceptional job. Tilly is always happy to see her—even when she’s not keen on a nail trim.

We switched from just nail trims to the Bath & Blow Out -SHORT HAIR service, and we're so glad we did. Our dog’s coat comes out incredibly soft and shiny. Plus the complimentary bandanas are very cute.

We also had a last-minute scheduling change today, and the team was so accommodating. Elen did a great job. The whole staff is wonderful.

Look at that shiny head.

I brought my Golden here for a groom and was super impressed. Jade was her groomer and they did an excellent job in a very short amount of time - I also appreciate being given a heads up of when she would be ready for pickup. Definitely will be back!

✅️ Wonderful customer service
✅️ Grooming for my dog went well and I brought him home with a cute bandana
✅️ Highly recommend grooming service

Julie is amazing! My havanese used to have a harder time at grooming, but he is managing much better with Julie. She also gives him an adorable and very precise cut. She is very communicative and it seems the dogs love and trust her. Highly recommend!

This is a long overdue review, but Puppers Palace gave our dog Boba a great and warm welcome to Vancouver! This was his first time seeing a groomer since venturing off to BC, and we were extremely nervous as he had only been to one groomer since a puppy + he struggles in stressful and overstimulating environments. The experts at Pupper palace created such a safe space for him, and gave us the utmost comfort and reassurance that he would have a good experience and he did! We were so proud of him and we can’t wait to bring him back soon. Seriously, these are great people here at PP and you will not regret bringing your dog here for a groom!
It was Murphys first time and we’re so happy with Julie’s work!! He came out looking handsome and feeling happy which is most important. Will definitely be returning for regular visits!
My dog always comes back looking handsome.
Great service and kind, patient staff

Jade and the team at Pupper Palace did an amazing job with my older collie who suffers from arthritis. They were very gentle, understanding, patient and skilled at bathing and grooming a large, older dog. I can't speak highly enough of Pupper Palace! Highly recommended!!

Our usual was super busy so we went here, it’s also closer. We brought two dogs and we were a little disappointed. Both were trimmed but seems to be uneven and paws weren’t done enough. Our Pomeranian usually gets a teddy cut but they didn’t want to do it because pomeranians aren’t “supposed” to get shorter cuts. We had a say in how we wanted to have it done but they wouldn’t do it. If you have specific preferences, I’d say to try elsewhere!
